cases.input: Headcount/method A/population P1 changes to FTE/method B/population P2.
cases.expect: Metric identity remains; a new immutable definition version is created and is non-comparable unless reconciled.

cases.input: One reporting period has no observation.
cases.expect: The period remains missing or unknown and is never substituted with zero.

cases.input: Historical source data is recalculated under a successor definition.
cases.expect: New observations pin the successor version; old observations remain unchanged.

cases.input: A semi-additive metric is summed over an unsupported time dimension.
cases.expect: Aggregation fails closed under the dimension rule.

cases.input: Two versions differ but an approved restatement method and evidence exist.
cases.expect: Comparability is comparable-with-restatement and references the method and evidence.
